title: A right orthogonal to a shift-stable class is triangulated
statement: Let $\mathcal T$ be a pre-triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category], and let $\mathcal P$ be a class of objects stable under every integer shift. Define $\mathcal P^\perp$ to be the full subcategory of objects $I$ such that every morphism $P\to I$ is zero for every $P\in\mathcal P$. Then $\mathcal P^\perp$ is replete, contains zero objects, is stable under every integer shift, and contains the third vertex of a distinguished triangle whenever it contains the other two. No smallness assumption on $\mathcal P$ is required.
